geometry: A ten-by-four rectangular illuminated bar with an inner highlight and a separable horizontal and vertical gradient glow.
limitations: Smooth curves and gradients approximate the source antialiasing. Native and 8x renders inspected.
qt5_compatibility: Rewritten without <mask>, <clipPath> or <filter>, which Qt5's SVG renderer ignores: masked gradient products became 1px strips, clips became hard-stop gradients or even-odd paths, and blur became stacked translucent shapes.
